rawContent: What an honor to spend time with @Jerickaduncan to talk about @TIMESUPLDF and the amazing survivors we support. It’s no surprise that new @CBSNews polling shows that #metoo and #TimesUp are reshaping our society. There’s no turning back.

I support Black women-in their decisions to tell their stories, in their decisions not to tell their stories, in their ability to be treated fairly and with dignity. In their ability to be safe at home, at work, in schools. This is OUR movement. #MeToo #TimesUp
Read this statement from the Russell Simmons #SilenceBreakers. #MeToo

These women came forward inspired by #MeToo, inspired by the #SilenceBreakers. They wondered whether we would be ready to receive and listen to Black women tell their stories. Watch this clip, listen to their stories, don’t turn away.

“The #MeToo movement, ignited in 2017 and originated by Tarana Burke, a Black woman, changed the trajectory of our lives. We are now strong, resilient and courageous warriors, and your time is up.” https://t.co/Hi6NoBJAo0

In awe of the #SilenceBreakers who let me moderate a panel about the new film @OnTheRecordDoc. Thank you for giving us the gift of your stories. Will you show up for these women? That’s the only thing that matters. @deardrewdixon #MeToo #SilenceBreakers #BlackWomen https://t.co/LrBdqETaHo

@OnTheRecordDoc is in the world as are the stories of several of the Russell Simmons survivors. When you see the film you will grapple with critical questions of power, privilege, white supremacy and misogyny. And you will be challenged to show up for Black women. #MeToo
We’re creating the world that we all deserve. Thank you for your leadership! #BeHeard #MeToo
Just back from travel to turn on the #DemDebate2020 to get the second question about #MeToo. I apparently have impeccable timing.

That #DemDebate exchange on #MeToo is a whole THREAD. First, Bloomberg can offer to release people from NDAs. It might be that some people want to be released. It might be that others do not. But an offer to release people from NDAs is not the same as disclosing details
Finishing the night in such deep gratitude for the #silencebreakers and the millions who are continuing to power this movement forward. #MeToo
